info.name: WanoApp Backend — Complete API
info.description:
Generated from the registered FastAPI OpenAPI schema and Strawberry GraphQL schema, with source-based examples.

Import this collection; set base_url (no trailing slash), username and password in Variables. Run Authentication > Login Json to save token/current_user_id automatically. A separate environment is optional. Set target IDs and real media URLs before using resource APIs. Optional query filters without defaults are present but unchecked.

All 100 registered HTTP operations are included, plus individual GraphQL queries/mutations and workflow variants. GraphQL subscriptions use WebSocket: see wanoapp.subscriptions.json and README.md.

Examples use fake credentials/IDs/URLs, not repository secrets. Request-body schemas and parameter constraints are documented inside requests. Do not run the entire collection blindly: it contains deletion, broadcast, ingestion and publishing operations. See README.md for setup, workflows, verification limits and known backend issues.
